messages.subject: Lyra — royalty landing and cash-flow model
messages.plaintextBody:
Martin,

Elena has built a royalty and value model (Project_Lyra_RoyaltyModel.xlsx) reflecting the executed-case assumptions. Summary: at 6.0% and our projected volumes, Veridian's cumulative royalties over years 1–6 are c. £85m, and total receipts (including the £4.5m upfront and £2m milestone) c. £94m, with an NPV at your 12% discount rate of c. £60m. We're proposing to hold royalty at 6.0% and settle the cap at 125%, offering to split the £2m milestone into two £1m tranches to help Marrick's cash-flow. Grateful for your confirmation.

James Osei
Senior Associate

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Lyra — royalty landing and cash-flow model
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

The model looks right and the landing is fine by me. 6.0% is the floor — please don't go below it. Splitting the milestone is no problem; the second tranche a year later is immaterial to us. Approved to proceed on that basis.

Martin Easton | CFO, Veridian Photonics Limited
